method: Our chance = 75/25 log-odds blend of the no-vig market with our model (goals: Poisson from 2026 per-app rate shrunk to league history x start probability; shots: hit rate on starts shrunk toward the market with 8 phantom starts; team: multiplicative attack/defence strength); no-vig = book price de-vigged 6%; NHL Lab tiers (75/25 market blend, EV 2%+; Bet needs 2+ books and confirmed XI).
